name: GuitarSet 1.1.0 pinned acoustic smoke references (not engine predictions)

cases.reference_method: GuitarSet v1.1.0 note_midi JAMS annotations; MIDI rounded to nearest semitone; onset/end preserved; reference-only 5 s polyphony selection, first valid performer-00 track
cases.limitations: Acoustic microphone recording only; one deterministic window is smoke/reference coverage, not a representative frozen benchmark or unseen-data claim.

dataset.attribution: GuitarSet: Qingyang Xi, Rachel M. Bittner, Johan Pauwels, Xuzhou Ye and Juan P. Bello (2018), DOI 10.5281/zenodo.3371780. Derived smoke windows/reference JSON retain attribution and record crop/MIDI rounding changes.
dataset.reference_method: Published hexaphonic-pickup-derived note_midi JAMS and pitch-contour annotations, paired with microphone audio; annotations are fallible, not independently hand-verified by RoughScore.

dataset.exclusion_policy: Exclude two constant annotation shifts reported in primary issue #5 and duplicated-note track reported in issue #4; do not silently repair. Smoke selection is restricted to performer 00, distinct from these errors, and is not a representative frozen benchmark.
limitations: Acoustic recordings do not supply distorted/dual-guitar band-mix reference stems.
Basic Pitch's training configuration includes GuitarSet; evaluating that model here is not necessarily held-out evidence.
Archive MD5 is the publisher integrity checksum; fetched/derived members also receive SHA256 in the receipt.
